Experience: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Providing and erection of Cooling tower spares / Assembly of value not less than Rs.3.1 Lakhs in the last five years (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) in any Thermal Power Stations of 210 MW or above capacity / Process Industries.As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload Work Done Certificate issued by competent authority for an amount not less than Rs. 3.1 Lakhs.(Work done of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year 2026-27).

Financial Turnover : The intending bidder in his name should have achieved minimum average annual financial turnover of Rs. 6.2 lakhs in any two years during the preceding 5 financial years (2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof of this, the bidder shall upload the certified copy of Profit & Loss Account or Turn over Certificates duly certified by the Chartered Accountant (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year 2026-27.)
